app.resetConfirm: Reset the demo back to its starting data?
app.colophon: MediThread - IIITDM HealthTech, "Lost in Transit". Sample data only. The interaction and duplicate-test rules are illustrative and are not medical advice.
timeline.title: The thread
timeline.searchPh: Search the chart - diagnoses, providers, notes
timeline.emptyBody: No record matches that search. Clear the search or switch the type filter.
timeline.docGone: That file is no longer stored in this browser.
timeline.docOmitted: Original file not included - the extracted values were shared instead.
labs.title: Lab trends
labs.needTwo: One {test} result on file. A trend needs two or more.
labs.improving: Trending down since the first result - share this instead of repeating the test.
labs.neutral: Share this trend with your next doctor rather than repeating the test.
demo.title: What this demo shows
demo.lostBody: Paper slips, PDFs and photos from ten different providers end up in one searchable chart.
demo.recallBody: A medicine list and an emergency card are generated from the chart, not from memory.
demo.repeatsBody: A per-test window flags a result you already have before it is ordered again.
demo.insecureBody: Shares expire, can be revoked, and every view is written to the audit trail.
demo.note: Built for the IIITDM HealthTech brief, "Lost in Transit".
meds.title: Current medicines
meds.tryIbuprofen: Try "Ibuprofen" to see the conflict the chart catches.
meds.clearBody: No known interaction with the current list in the demo rules.
meds.allergies: Allergies on file: {list}. Shown to every doctor and on the emergency card.
meds.preventionBody: In August 2023, CityCare Clinic treated a fever with Ibuprofen. Nobody there knew about the Telmisartan started five months earlier, because that prescription was a photo on a different phone. This chart flags the pair before it is taken.
meds.windows: Duplicate tests are checked against per-test windows - HbA1c 90 days, creatinine 60, LDL 120. A doctor who orders an HbA1c three weeks after one already exists gets a nudge to open the existing result.
meds.scopeBody: The rule set here is illustrative. A real deployment would check against an approved drug database and clinical decision support rules.
share.title: Create a share
share.readyBody: The records travel inside the link itself, so it opens on a phone or another laptop even if that device has never seen MediThread.
share.omitted: {n} attached file(s) were over {kb} KB, so the extracted values are shared but the originals are not.
share.receive: Receive a note from a doctor
share.receiveBody: MediThread has no server, so a doctor cannot write into your chart directly. They send you a note code instead - paste it here and it joins your timeline.
share.noShares: No shares yet. Create one to hand a doctor exactly what they need.
share.revokeBody: Revocation is enforced locally in this demo. Production uses a server-side consent registry. Until the link expires on its own, revoking blocks it in this browser only.
share.noAccess: Nothing has been opened or changed yet.
er.title: Emergency card
er.accessBody: Enter the four-digit PIN on the patient's card. No login, read only.
er.wrongPin: That PIN does not match. {n} attempt(s) left before this device is locked out.
er.locked: That PIN does not match. 5 failed attempts - reload the page to try again.
er.scanBody: Scanning opens the PIN-gated emergency view. No login, read only, and every open is logged. Demo PIN is {pin}.
upload.title: Add a record
upload.drop: Drop a file here, or choose one
upload.dropBody: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP. Up to 10 MB. The file stays on this device - nothing is uploaded to a server.
upload.progressNote: First run downloads the OCR language packs (English, हिन्दी, தமிழி). After that it works offline.
upload.readOkBody: Found {n} item(s). Check it below and correct anything that looks wrong - nothing is saved until you confirm.
upload.values: Values found - edit any of them
upload.medsFoundBody: Saved onto the record only. They are checked against your current list below - they are not added to your medicines until you do that yourself.
upload.h1b: The file goes into your browser's IndexedDB. Nothing is sent anywhere.
upload.h2b: Text PDFs are read from their text layer. Photos and scanned PDFs go through OCR in English, हिन्दी and தமிழி.
upload.h3b: Recognised values, dates and medicines are a draft. Nothing is saved until you confirm it.
upload.h4b: On confirm, the duplicate-test guard and the interaction checker both run.
upload.h5b: A shared link carries the original file only if it is under {kb} KB. Bigger files share the extracted values and say so.
upload.ocrCaveat: OCR is not perfect. Always check the recognised numbers against the document before saving.
upload.dupBody: {test} was done {days} days ago ({date}, {provider}, result {value}). The window for this test is {window} days - sharing the earlier result is cheaper than repeating it.
upload.needTitle: Give the record a title before saving.
upload.errType: That file type is not supported. Use a PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP.
upload.errSize: That file is {size} MB. The limit is 10 MB - try a photo instead of a scan.
upload.errStore: The file could not be stored in this browser, so it was not saved.
upload.errNetwork: Text recognition needs to download its language data once, and it could not reach the network. Fill the form in by hand instead.
upload.errUnreadable: That file could not be read. Fill the form in by hand instead.
upload.errNoValues: We could not read any values out of that file. Fill the form in yourself - everything below is editable.
doc.cannotOpenBody: The link is damaged, expired, or made by another version of MediThread.
doc.demoHint: For the demo: create a link in the Patient tab and paste it here. The emergency view is PIN-gated and needs no share.
doc.external: Opened on a device with no MediThread data
doc.externalBody: The records came from inside the link itself. Revocation is enforced locally in this demo; production uses a server-side consent registry.
doc.verifiedBody: {n} records, expires {when}. The open has been logged on the patient's chart.
doc.writeBackBody: MediThread has no server, so a note cannot be pushed into the patient's chart from here. Build the note, then send the patient the code - they paste it into Patient › Sharing › Receive a note.
doc.clearBody: No known interaction with their current medicines.
doc.consentBody: In production this screen shows nothing until a patient shares. It is visible here so a judge can walk the whole flow from one browser.
summary.title: Clinician summary
toast.copyFailed: Copy failed - select it and copy it manually
err.badJson: That file is not a MediThread chart.
cardonly.iosHint: iPhone does not open the print sheet from a web page. Use Safari’s Share button and choose Print, or just take a screenshot - this view is the whole card with nothing around it.
cardonly.hint: Use your browser’s Print command to save this card as a PDF.
